System Unit Declaration.description: Declare a top-level I system unit with required hardware capabilities and main routine.

Require Capability.description: Declare a compile-time security capability token required for privileged hardware operations.

Routine Definition.description: Define a deterministic routine with explicit parameter and return types.

Bare-Metal Kernel Entry.description: Declare a freestanding kernel entry point for bare-metal execution (no OS runtime).

Immutable Binding (bind).description: Declare an immutable value. In I, bind is strictly immutable to ensure mathematical determinism.

Mutable Variable (mut).description: Declare a mutable local variable allocated on the CPU stack.

Conditional Branch.description: Conditional execution branch (equivalent to if/else) with strict boolean evaluation.

Cycle Loop.description: Deterministic step-by-step cycle loop using modular wrapping (+%) arithmetic.

Repeat Until Loop.description: Loop that repeats until the condition evaluates to true.

Memory Layout Definition.description: Define a packed binary memory layout with exact byte offsets matching hardware registers or network packets.

Compile-Time Verification.description: Compile-time static assertion. Evaluated during semantic analysis; fails build if false.

Hardware Port Out8 (@out8).description: Emit x86 OUT DX, AL instruction. Writes 8-bit byte to hardware I/O port. Requires 'hardware_io' capability.

Hardware Port In8 (@in8).description: Emit x86 IN AL, DX instruction. Reads 8-bit byte from hardware I/O port. Requires 'hardware_io' capability.

Raw Memory Load32 (@load32).description: Read 32-bit unsigned word from raw memory address. Requires 'raw_memory' capability.

Raw Memory Store32 (@store32).description: Write 32-bit unsigned word to raw memory address. Requires 'raw_memory' capability.

Clear Interrupts (@cli).description: Emit x86 CLI instruction to disable CPU hardware interrupts. Requires 'interrupt_control' or 'kernel_ring0'.

Set Interrupts (@sti).description: Emit x86 STI instruction to enable CPU hardware interrupts. Requires 'interrupt_control' or 'kernel_ring0'.

Halt Processor (halt).description: Emit x86 HLT instruction. Suspends processor until next hardware interrupt.

Direct Linux Syscall (@syscall).description: Invoke direct System V Linux kernel syscall instruction (0x0F 0x05). Requires 'host_syscall' capability.

Software Trap / Panic (trap).description: Emit invalid opcode UD2 instruction to trigger immediate processor trap on critical invariant failure.
